title: Transitive symmetry
statement: Let $\beta$ be a type and let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\beta$. The function is transitive symmetric if, for every pair of coordinate indices $i,i'$, there is a permutation $\pi$ of the coordinates that sends $i$ to $i'$ and leaves $f$ unchanged on every input when the input is permuted by $\pi$.
